subject: Deployment options follow-up — SSO / KMS / log retention
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Deployment options follow-up — SSO / KMS / log retention

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align internal stakeholders on the right deployment path (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private):

Call recap:
- Primary use: production LLM inference for customer support triage and redaction pipelines.
- Peak load expected: ~2k rps inference across bursty periods; steady-state ~200 rps.
- Security / compliance asks surfaced: enterprise SSO integration, customer-managed key (BYOK / HSM), and extended log retention (>= 2 years).

What we heard that drives deployment mode:
- SSO + SCIM for console/ops: Hosted & Dedicated both support standard SAML/OIDC integrations; SCIM provisioning available on Dedicated and Private.
- KMS/HSM / BYOK: Private deployments support full BYOK with HSM integrations. Dedicated can offer key isolation and enterprise KMS integrations in some cases (we'll confirm), but full offline HSM/AZ HSM appliances are generally Private-only.
- Log retention / audit logs: Hosted provides standard audit logs (90 days by default, configurable with add-ons). Dedicated can increase retention with add-on packages; Private gives customer control over retention and external logging sinks.

Attachments I shared: deployment-options-matrix.pdf (high-level mapping), redwood-security-overview.pdf. I also attached a short SSO/KMS questionnaire (SSO_KMS_questions.xlsx) so you can capture the specifics.

To move forward:
1) Please confirm the three must-have constraints that would force Private deployment for you (BYOK/HSM required, >= 2 year log retention, air-gapped/on-prem).
2) If any of those are "yes," we'll schedule a technical deep-dive (Rishi and Vivek) to scope Private vs Dedicated implications (networking, cost, timeline).
3) If none are must-haves, we can scope Dedicated for predictable capacity with enterprise SSO and enhanced retention.

Proposed times for a technical call next week: Tue/Wed 10-12 PDT. Let me know what works.

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Marissa — thanks for the recap. A couple quick clarifications from my side and procurement is looped for timeline/contract questions.

Questions:
1) Our security team is firm that BYOK with HSM-backed keys is a must for the model outputs stored longer than 30 days. Does that requirement automatically rule out Hosted?
2) For SSO: we use Azure AD (SAML + SCIM). Are there limitations on user provisioning if we choose Dedicated vs Private?
3) Log retention: we need audit logs preserved for 24 months and ability to export to our Splunk instance. Is that supported in Dedicated or only Private?

Date: Mon, 04 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment options follow-up — SSO / KMS / log retention

Tom / Elena — great questions. High-level answers below; Rishi & Vivek are cc'd and will join the technical call to confirm specifics and ops implications.

Short answers (summary):
- BYOK / HSM: Hosted API does not support customer-managed HSM/BYOK for encryption at rest today. That capability is a primary driver for Private deployments. Dedicated can sometimes support customer-managed KMS integrations (e.g., cloud KMS BYOK) depending on the contract and cloud setup, but if you require hardware HSM appliances or an air-gapped key store, Private is the recommended path.
- SSO / SCIM (Azure AD):
  - Hosted: supports OIDC / SAML sign-on for the Redwood Console and API key provisioning flows; SCIM provisioning is limited.
  - Dedicated: supports SAML and SCIM provisioning (recommended for orgs with automated user lifecycle).
  - Private: full control and SCIM/SAML as part of customer-managed identity stack.
- Log retention / export:
  - Hosted: default 90-day audit logs; extended retention possible as an add-on (we'll need to size storage and cost). Export to Splunk via secure log forwarding is supported via our logging integration add-on.
  - Dedicated: longer retention (configurable) and secure export to customer Splunk/ELK.
  - Private: customer controls retention and can send logs directly to internal sinks.

Bottom line: If BYOK with HSM is a hard requirement and/or you need air-gapped on-prem keys, Private is the right fit. If BYOK can be satisfied with cloud KMS integrations and you want reserved capacity with enterprise SSO/SCIM and longer retention, Dedicated is worth scoping.

Next steps:
- Please confirm which of the following are "must-haves" vs "nice-to-haves": BYOK (HSM), >=24mo log retention, air-gapped keys.
- I'll schedule a 60-min technical scoping with Rishi & Vivek (they can cover networking, KMS patterns, and timeline).
- I'll share a short deployment-cost/ETA estimate for Dedicated vs Private after the scoping call.

I've attached the matrix again (deployment-options-matrix.pdf) to make tradeoffs explicit.

Best,
Marissa
